mmlu.description: Answer multiple-choice questions spanning 57 academic and professional subjects.
mmlu.input: Subject question with four answer choices

big-bench.description: Compare language models across diverse contributed tasks rather than one fixed exam format.
big-bench.input: Task-specific prompt, sometimes with answer choices
big-bench.output: Generated text or scores for candidate answers
big-bench.assessment: Task-defined metric; no single universal grader
big-bench.date_note: Initial results presented at the ICLR workshop; the full preprint followed in June 2022.

mteb.description: Compare sentence and document embeddings across tasks such as retrieval, clustering and semantic similarity. This is the original text suite.
mteb.input: Text queries, passages or sentence pairs, depending on the task
mteb.assessment: Use each task’s metric and identify the suite or subset behind any reported average.
mteb.date_note: First paper on the original text embedding suite, not the later multimodal extension.

helm.description: Compare models on the same scenarios across metrics such as accuracy, calibration and efficiency.
helm.input: Scenario-specific text prompts or answer choices
helm.output: Generations or likelihoods, depending on scenario
helm.assessment: Scenario-specific metrics including accuracy, robustness and calibration
helm.first_author_affil: Stanford University (Center for Research on Foundation Models / Stanford HAI)

agieval.description: Solve objective questions from academic and professional exams, including free-response and multiple-choice items.
agieval.input: Exam question, sometimes with supplied answer choices
agieval.assessment: Choice accuracy; exact match or F1 for blanks

chatbot-arena.description: Collect blind head-to-head votes on two model responses to a user’s own prompt.
chatbot-arena.input: User prompt shared with two anonymous models
chatbot-arena.assessment: Users vote head-to-head; votes determine relative ratings
chatbot-arena.date_note: Dated announcement of the arena; voting had already started.

c-eval.description: Answer Chinese multiple-choice questions across 52 subjects spanning several levels of difficulty.
c-eval.input: A Chinese question and four answer options
c-eval.assessment: Multiple-choice accuracy; specify the subject aggregation and prompting setup.

ifeval.description: Follow natural-language constraints whose satisfaction can be checked without a human or model judge.
ifeval.input: Prompt with one or more verifiable constraints
ifeval.assessment: Rule checks; strict/loose prompt- and instruction-level accuracy

mmlu-pro.description: Answer harder, reasoning-oriented academic questions with more distractors than the original MMLU.
mmlu-pro.input: Multisubject question with up to ten options
mmlu-pro.assessment: Accuracy against answer keys across subjects

humanitys-last-exam.description: Answer closed-ended expert questions across disciplines, including questions that require images.
humanitys-last-exam.input: Expert question, sometimes with an image
humanitys-last-exam.output: Selected or short answer with stated confidence
humanitys-last-exam.assessment: Paper reports model-judged accuracy and RMS calibration error
humanitys-last-exam.date_note: Release of the exam and results, one day before the arXiv v1 submission.

aa-intelligence-index.description: The v5 index regrades the CritPt v2 component with the benchmark authors’ grading improvements.
aa-intelligence-index.input: Results from nine component evaluations under v5.0.1
aa-intelligence-index.output: One composite score for a model
aa-intelligence-index.assessment: Four categories weighted 25% each, including the revised physics grader.
aa-intelligence-index.date_note: Official history gives November 2026. An AA article dated November 5 names this exact version: firm available-by evidence, not proof it launched November 5.

healthbench.description: Write the next response to a patient or clinician. Each of 5,000 conversations has its own physician-written criteria for what a good answer should include or avoid.
healthbench.input: A health conversation ending in a user or clinician message
healthbench.assessment: A model grader checks weighted physician-written criteria; scores are averaged across conversations.
healthbench.date_note: Public launch; the paper followed on 13 May. Hard and Consensus are variants, not the standard full-set score.

gdpval.description: Produce deliverables for professional tasks across 44 occupations.
gdpval.assessment: Expert blind comparisons of model and human deliverables
gdpval.date_note: Original public benchmark. Do not substitute it for internal GDPval v2; GDPval-AA is also a distinct administration.

apex-agents.description: Produce a professional deliverable in a shared workspace for a banking, consulting or legal assignment. This is the agent benchmark, not the tool-free APEX suite.
apex-agents.input: A professional brief, files and workplace applications
apex-agents.output: A client-ready answer or work product
apex-agents.assessment: Expert rubrics: full-task pass rate and mean criterion score
apex-agents.date_note: Original launch of APEX-Agents; distinct from the APEX umbrella and tool-free APEX-1.

lifeval.description: Use personal context and files to complete a practical everyday task.
lifeval.input: Personal task, context, reference files and tools
lifeval.assessment: Rubric-based grading against the task and starting state
lifeval.date_note: OpenAI public announcement; the technical paper followed. Not LifeEval, the unrelated egocentric-video evaluation.

apex-agents-1-1.description: Deliver professional work from a document-rich environment. Version 1.1 refines the tasks and judges ambiguous or contradictory answers differently.
apex-agents-1-1.input: A work brief, reference files and workplace tools
apex-agents-1-1.assessment: Expert-authored rubric criteria; report mean rubric score or full-task pass rate with the 1.1 grading protocol.

aa-intelligence-index-1-0-1-3.description: The publisher groups the early index editions together, beginning in January 2024; separate start dates and comparable scoring specifications for 1.0, 1.1, 1.2 and 1.3 are not supplied.
aa-intelligence-index-1-0-1-3.input: Component evaluation results under the original methodology
aa-intelligence-index-1-0-1-3.output: One composite score for a model
aa-intelligence-index-1-0-1-3.assessment: The published early composite rating; the current normalization and weights do not reconstruct it.
aa-intelligence-index-1-0-1-3.date_note: The author gives only January 2024 as the start of the combined v1.0–1.3 interval. January 31 is the upper bound of that month, not a launch day. Do not split four records with identical invented dates.

aa-intelligence-index-2-0.description: Read the composite under the v2.0 methodology. The publisher dates this version to February 11 through August 4, 2025.
aa-intelligence-index-2-0.input: Evaluation results collected under index v2.0
aa-intelligence-index-2-0.output: One composite score for a model
aa-intelligence-index-2-0.assessment: The model’s v2.0 composite; compare within that index version.
aa-intelligence-index-2-0.date_note: Dated first-party announcement or explicit start boundary in the version history.

aa-intelligence-index-2-1.description: The score incorporates IFBench and AIME 2025. MATH-500 and AIME 2024 were retired from the index.
aa-intelligence-index-2-1.input: Constituent scores from the v2.1 evaluation set
aa-intelligence-index-2-1.output: One composite score for a model
aa-intelligence-index-2-1.assessment: Aggregate with the v2.1 evaluation weights.
aa-intelligence-index-2-1.date_note: Dated first-party announcement or explicit start boundary in the version history.

aa-intelligence-index-2-2.description: The index adds the Artificial Analysis Long Context Reasoning evaluation, and adjusts its weights.
aa-intelligence-index-2-2.output: One composite score for a model
aa-intelligence-index-2-2.assessment: Aggregate with the v2.2 evaluation weights.
aa-intelligence-index-2-2.date_note: Dated first-party announcement or explicit start boundary in the version history.

aa-intelligence-index-3-0.description: The index incorporates terminal work, telecom customer assistance, MMLU-Pro and LiveCodeBench with a new weighting scheme.
aa-intelligence-index-3-0.input: Constituent task results under the v3.0 methodology
aa-intelligence-index-3-0.output: One composite score for a model
aa-intelligence-index-3-0.assessment: Aggregate under the v3.0 scoring and weights.
aa-intelligence-index-3-0.date_note: Dated first-party announcement or explicit start boundary in the version history.

aa-intelligence-index-4-0.description: The index moves to four equally weighted categories, adds knowledge-work, physics and factual-knowledge evaluations and removes three saturated tests.
aa-intelligence-index-4-0.input: Results for agentic tasks, coding, science and general capabilities
aa-intelligence-index-4-0.output: One composite score for a model
aa-intelligence-index-4-0.date_note: Dated first-party announcement or explicit start boundary in the version history.

aa-intelligence-index-4-1.description: The index replaces earlier Terminal-Bench and τ tests with Terminal-Bench 2.1 and τ³-Banking, upgrades GDPval-AA and removes IFBench.
aa-intelligence-index-4-1.input: Agent, coding, scientific reasoning and general evaluation results
aa-intelligence-index-4-1.output: One composite score for a model
aa-intelligence-index-4-1.assessment: Category weights: agents 34%, coding 24%, scientific reasoning 24%, general 18%.
aa-intelligence-index-4-1.date_note: Dated first-party announcement or explicit start boundary in the version history.

aa-intelligence-index-4-1-1.description: A grading update uses the revised τ³-Banking tasks and a different judge for HLE, AA-LCR and AA-Omniscience.
aa-intelligence-index-4-1-1.input: Constituent task results including four updated grading configurations
aa-intelligence-index-4-1-1.output: One composite score for a model
aa-intelligence-index-4-1-1.assessment: Aggregate under v4.1 weights with the v4.1.1 grading protocols.
aa-intelligence-index-4-1-1.date_note: Dated first-party announcement or explicit start boundary in the version history.

aa-intelligence-index-4-2.description: The index adds AA-Briefcase and GDP.pdf, removes GPQA Diamond, and changes long-context and scientific-code grading.
aa-intelligence-index-4-2.input: Constituent scores including knowledge-work and long-document tasks
aa-intelligence-index-4-2.output: One composite score for a model
aa-intelligence-index-4-2.date_note: Dated first-party announcement or explicit start boundary in the version history.

aa-intelligence-index-4-3.description: The index adopts AutomationBench-AA and Terminal-Bench 4.0, replacing τ³-Banking and Terminal-Bench 2.1.
aa-intelligence-index-4-3.input: Constituent evaluations including AutomationBench-AA and Terminal-Bench 4.0
aa-intelligence-index-4-3.output: One composite score for a model
aa-intelligence-index-4-3.assessment: Weighted aggregate with the v4.3 components and document handling.
aa-intelligence-index-4-3.date_note: Dated first-party announcement or explicit start boundary in the version history.

aa-intelligence-index-4-3-1.description: The pairwise judge panels used for AA-Briefcase and GDPval-AA v2 were refreshed; the rubric panels did not change.
aa-intelligence-index-4-3-1.input: Constituent scores with the September pairwise judging configuration
aa-intelligence-index-4-3-1.output: One composite score for a model
aa-intelligence-index-4-3-1.assessment: v4.3 composite using the v4.3.1 judging panel.
aa-intelligence-index-4-3-1.date_note: Official version history places v4.3.1 in September 2026 ahead of v4.3.2. The later revision was already explicitly reported by AA on September 29; this is a conservative upper bound, not a v4.3.1 launch date.

aa-intelligence-index-4-3-2.description: GDPval-AA and AA-Briefcase use a revised pairwise fitting method; the GDPval-AA scale also has a new anchor.
aa-intelligence-index-4-3-2.input: Constituent scores with the v4.3.2 ratings methodology
aa-intelligence-index-4-3-2.output: One composite score for a model
aa-intelligence-index-4-3-2.assessment: Weighted aggregate using the updated rating estimates and anchor.
aa-intelligence-index-4-3-2.date_note: Official changelog dates introduction to September. The publisher explicitly named v4.3.2 in a September 29 model evaluation; use that day as an available-by bound, not the exact launch date.

aa-intelligence-index-5-0.description: Nine evaluations span knowledge work, coding, science and general tasks. New components include Terminal-Bench-Science and FrontierCode 2.0.
aa-intelligence-index-5-0.input: Results on the v5.0 component evaluations
aa-intelligence-index-5-0.output: One composite score for a model
aa-intelligence-index-5-0.assessment: Four equally weighted categories, using the v5.0 component definitions and grading.
aa-intelligence-index-5-0.date_note: Dated first-party announcement or explicit start boundary in the version history.

gdpval-aa.description: Produce workplace deliverables in Artificial Analysis’ agentic implementation of OpenAI’s public GDPval tasks.
gdpval-aa.input: A professional brief, reference files and the AA agent environment
gdpval-aa.assessment: Blind pairwise assessments summarized as a relative rating under the original AA protocol.
gdpval-aa.date_note: The publisher announced the GDPval-AA leaderboard on December 10. Its independently dated Stirrup article that day confirms the GDPval-AA evaluation was being released later that day.

gdpval-aa-2-0.description: Use the v2 professional-work environment with revised dependencies and a larger turn budget.
gdpval-aa-2-0.input: A professional brief, reference files and the AA agent environment
gdpval-aa-2-0.assessment: Pairwise evaluations by a panel of judges; the v2 rating scale is anchored to human expert performance at 1000.
gdpval-aa-2-0.date_note: The source explicitly announces the GDPval-AA v2 upgrade.

gdpval-aa-2-1.description: The professional-work task protocol is retained while the relative ratings are recalibrated.
gdpval-aa-2-1.input: A professional brief, reference files and the AA agent environment
gdpval-aa-2-1.assessment: Crowd-BT fitted ratings with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max) fixed at 1600; do not equate the Elo scale to v2.0.
gdpval-aa-2-1.date_note: The AA methodology dates this change to September under Index v4.3.2; AA had reported v4.3.2 by September 29. Exact launch day not established.

finance-agent.description: Research financial questions using public company filings and tools.
finance-agent.input: A financial research question, filings and search tools
finance-agent.output: A supported numerical or textual answer
finance-agent.assessment: Reference and rubric-based accuracy on the named Finance Agent dataset.
finance-agent.date_note: Original benchmark paper arXiv v1 timestamp.

finance-agent-1-1.description: Answer revised professional finance questions with clarified dates, updated tool use and explicit answer submission.
finance-agent-1-1.input: A financial research question, filings and search tools
finance-agent-1-1.output: A supported numerical or textual answer
finance-agent-1-1.assessment: Model-based grading with revised rounding guidance and a three-evaluation vote.
finance-agent-1-1.date_note: Substantive author data commit for FAB v1.1. An earlier code commit labeled v1.1 is not sufficient to establish the revised dataset.

finance-agent-2-0.description: Research analyst workflows including comparables, precedents, earnings and disclosures rather than the original retrieval-focused categories.
finance-agent-2-0.input: A financial research question, filings and search tools
finance-agent-2-0.output: A supported numerical or textual answer
finance-agent-2-0.assessment: Accuracy under the v2 tasks and financial research harness.
finance-agent-2-0.date_note: Vals’ own index changelog says Finance Agent v2 was in use on May 13. A component result is not the index aggregate.

finance-agent-2-1.description: Answer professional finance tasks under revised questions, rubrics and judging for hedged answers.
finance-agent-2-1.input: A financial research question, filings and search tools
finance-agent-2-1.output: A supported numerical or textual answer
finance-agent-2-1.assessment: Accuracy using the v2.1 judge panel and updated grading rubric.
finance-agent-2-1.date_note: Vals’ index changelog records the replacement with v2.1 on October 19; this is an available-by bound, not the later leaderboard refresh date.

lifearena.description: Compare assistants on people’s own everyday tasks.
lifearena.input: The same real user request and connected applications.
lifearena.assessment: Head-to-head user preferences aggregated over the recent evaluation window.

bencharena.description: Compare an agent loop with a stack on a shared question corpus.
bencharena.input: Factual, reasoning, legal, coding or metacognitive questions.
bencharena.output: System responses under each execution approach.
bencharena.assessment: Documented checks combine answer correctness with latency and token usage.
